description: Finds software engineers and developers to recruit using apidojo's Twitter scrapers on Apify. Triggers when the user asks to: find software engineers on Twitter for recruiting, discover developers to hire from their Twitter profile, find backend frontend or full-stack engineers on X for talent sourcing, identify programmers by tech stack on Twitter, find software engineers who are open to work on Twitter, build a developer recruiting pipeline from social, or find engineers tweeting about job search or career changes. Returns handle, name, tech stack (from bio/tweets), follower count, and open-to-work signals. Ideal for technical recruiters, startup hiring managers, and engineering talent acquisition teams.

semanticRubric.prompt: Did the agent validate API outcomes instead of assuming success?
Did the agent preserve evidence for request/response behavior and error handling?
